sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hey! How's your day going?
ParticipantA: Pretty good, actually. Just getting back to work.
ParticipantB: Oh, cool. What do you do?
ParticipantA: I manage a grocery store downtown.
ParticipantB: Oh, nice. That sounds busy. Do you get to do any gardening or yard work?
ParticipantA: Not really, mostly just managing people and stock. Sometimes I help pull weeds if my hands are free, but it's not my thing.
ParticipantB: Ah, okay. That makes sense. I'm a pharmacist, so I sit behind a desk all day.
ParticipantA: Oh, that's interesting. I heard pharmacists have to work outside sometimes? Is that true?
ParticipantB: Yeah, technically, but honestly? No. I barely touch grass. Actually, my cousin's wife is a landscape designer, though. She's my family's gardener basically.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? That's cool. My aunt used to garden all the time, then she got sick and couldn't lift the heavy stuff anymore. She just sat on the porch now.
ParticipantB: Oh no, that's tough. Yeah, that's exactly why I don't get into it. It's too much physical work for me. Do you like it when you do pull weeds though?
ParticipantA: Honestly? Not really. It's just chores. Sometimes I feel bad helping, but it's part of the job. I wish I had a green thumb like your cousin's wife.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I definitely envy her. I know a guy who's trying to build a raised bed garden but he's struggling. He keeps forgetting to water or the plants are dying.
ParticipantA: Ugh, that's annoying. I told my mom about my aunt and she said if I just buy pre-grown stuff from the store, it would be easier. She says it's easier than starting from seed.
ParticipantB: That sounds like a good idea. Maybe you should ask her about it next time you visit. I bet she'd have some tips.
ParticipantA: Yeah, maybe I will. But I'm still skeptical about gardening anyway. Seems like too much trouble for just flowers.
ParticipantB: I get that. I prefer buying plants to look good without the work. Does your store sell those kinds of plants?
ParticipantA: Yeah, actually. We have a big section with pre-grown stuff. People love buying those when they don't want the hassle.
ParticipantB: Perfect! I'll probably pick something up from you guys next week. Thanks for talking, it was nice.
ParticipantA: No problem. Glad we could chat. Take care!
ParticipantB: You too!
